newsitem.title: USA: Entergy accelerated recovery plan rejected.
newsitem.headline: Entergy accelerated recovery plan rejected.

text.p: Entergy Corp said the Louisiana Public Service Commission voted Thursday to not allow Entergy Louisiana Inc to begin immediate accelerated recovery of power plant construction costs.
The commission first wants to fully study the generic issues of competition; thus, Entergy's proposal for accelerated recovery now was judged to be premature, the company explained.
The company noted it has submitted its Transition to Competition Plan to the commission, describing it as an orderly transition to a deregulated environment.
The seven-year plan proposes a rate freeze and accelerated depreciation of nuclear assets that were deemed prudent by state regulators, Entergy said.
